task_sequence.title: Architecture contract: blueprint, AGENTS.md, verify script, lint rules
The Lite schema exists on a fresh project, so the frontend has real tables to build against
Prove the access model in code, because DB-1 makes RLS the authorization layer rather than a safety net
The frontend can import generated types and log into a populated workspace
The existing scaffold obeys the folder law, so no later task has to retrofit it
A local database that is the app's only read surface, so every later feature is offline-capable by construction
Atoms, theme and the provider tree exist, so every later component composes rather than invents
A user signs in and opens a workspace with a leader, a persona and a goal
Local writes reach Supabase and remote changes reach Dexie, so the app is correct online and offline before any feature depends on it
The workspace PDF renders, pans and zooms smoothly on a tablet
